    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Select the matching lock file
        run: cp composer.lock.php-8.5 composer.lock

      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs
          vendor/bin/infection --version

      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --with-uncovered
          --threads=max
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --min-msi=0
          --min-covered-msi=0
          --no-progress
          --logger-github

      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const stats = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('build/infection/infection.json', 'utf8')).stats;
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            for (const value of [stats.msi, stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
              if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
              }
            }
            const belowThreshold = stats.msi < minMsi || stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi;
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = `<!-- ${context.workflow}:msi -->`;
            const title = `[${context.workflow}] Mutation score below threshold`;
            const body = [
              marker,
              `Scheduled mutation testing on the default branch is below the required score.`,
              '',
              '| Metric | Actual | Required |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: |',
              `| MSI | ${stats.msi}% | ${minMsi}% |`,
              `| Covered MSI | ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              'The score is reported here without failing the workflow. Read build/infection/escaped.log in the run artifact for the mutants no test objected to.'
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading(`Mutation testing: ${context.workflow}`)
              .addRaw(`MSI: ${stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%). Covered MSI: ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`)
              .write();
            if (!belowThreshold) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }

      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: mutation-reports
          path: build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Renovate lock files

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - composer.json
      - composer.lock

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: renovate-lockfiles-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  refresh:
    name: Refresh the PHP compatibility lock files
    if: >-
      (github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'renovate[bot]' ||
       github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'mend-for-github-com[bot]') &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.head_ref, 'renovate/') &&
      github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the Renovate revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: none

      - name: Resolve dependencies for each supported PHP version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Global platform overrides preserve the shared manifest's content hash.
          # No packages are installed and no repository or dependency scripts run.
          original_lock="$(mktemp)"
          cp composer.lock "${original_lock}"
          trap 'cp "${original_lock}" composer.lock; rm -f "${original_lock}"' EXIT

          for php_version in 8.0 8.1 8.2 8.3 8.4; do
            cp "composer.lock.php-${php_version}" composer.lock
            composer --no-plugins config --global platform.php "${php_version}.0"
            composer update --no-install --no-scripts --no-plugins --prefer-dist
            composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
            cp composer.lock "composer.lock.php-${php_version}"
          done

      - name: Commit the lock files and run CI on the new revision
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git add composer.lock.php-8.0 composer.lock.php-8.1 composer.lock.php-8.2 composer.lock.php-8.3 composer.lock.php-8.4
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'The compatibility lock files are already current.'
            exit 0
          fi

          current_pr="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
          if [ "$(jq -r '.state' <<< "${current_pr}")" != 'open' ] ||
             [ "$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<< "${current_pr}")" != "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ]; then
            echo 'The PR changed while dependencies were resolving; leaving the new revision untouched.'
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message 'chore(deps): refresh PHP compatibility lock files'
          git push origin "HEAD:${HEAD_BRANCH}"

          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not start CI automatically. Dispatch explicitly
          # so Renovate sees checks for the commit containing the refreshed locks.
          gh workflow run ci.yml --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
            --ref "${HEAD_BRANCH}" --field "base_ref=${BASE_BRANCH}"
"}}

          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: build/docgen-cache
          key: docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: composer test:coverage

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          composer docgen -- --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  refresh:
    name: Refresh the Context7 library
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Request a refresh of the indexed documentation
        env:
          CONTEXT7_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONTEXT7_API_KEY }}
          LIBRARY_NAME: /${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -z "${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" ]; then
            echo '::error::The CONTEXT7_API_KEY repository secret is not set. Copy the key from https://context7.com/dashboard into Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions.'
            exit 1
          fi

          response_file="$(mktemp)"
          status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output "${response_file}" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --request POST https://context7.com/api/v1/refresh \
            --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" \
            --data "{\"libraryName\": \"${LIBRARY_NAME}\"}")"
          echo "HTTP ${status}: $(cat "${response_file}")"

          if [ "${status}" = '200' ]; then
            exit 0
          fi

          error_code="$(jq -r '.error // empty' "${response_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ "${status}" = '400' ] && [ "${error_code}" = 'too-early' ]; then
            echo "::notice::Context7 declined the refresh of ${LIBRARY_NAME} because its minimum interval since the last update has not passed. The next push after that interval refreshes the library."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "::error::Context7 rejected the refresh of ${LIBRARY_NAME} with HTTP ${status}. Check the response above: 401 means the CONTEXT7_API_KEY secret is wrong, 404 means the library is not registered under that name."
          exit 1

# Dependency updates

[Renovate](https://github.com/apps/renovate) checks the root Composer dependencies
and GitHub Actions. Its repository configuration is in [`renovate.json`](../renovate.json).
Dependency updates, including major versions, merge automatically after CI passes.
Composer ranges are widened instead of
replacing older supported major versions, and the PHP minimum remains unchanged.
The Dependency Dashboard is disabled because this repository does not use GitHub Issues.

## GitHub Apps

Install these official apps on `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit` (select only this repository
when choosing repository access):

1. [Renovate](https://github.com/apps/renovate/installations/new) creates and merges
   dependency PRs.
2. [Renovate Approve](https://github.com/apps/renovate-approve/installations/new)
   approves Renovate PRs whose description says automerge is enabled.

App installation is an account setting; merging the configuration PR does not
install either app. No personal access token or new repository secret is needed.
Keep the repository's Pull requests feature enabled so Renovate can open its PRs.

`platformAutomerge` is disabled deliberately: Renovate waits for all checks on the
current revision and an up-to-date branch before merging. This works with the
repository's direct-to-main workflow without introducing required PRs or enabling
GitHub's native auto-merge. If required reviews are added later, permit the
Renovate Approve app's review to satisfy them. See the
[Renovate automerge documentation](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/automerge/).

## Composer lock files

`composer.lock` is the PHP 8.5 lock file, used by Renovate, lint, mutation testing,
and documentation publishing. PHP 8.0–8.4 retain their version-specific
`composer.lock.php-*` files. For local development on an older PHP version, copy
the corresponding lock file to `composer.lock` before installing; restore the
tracked PHP 8.5 lock before committing unrelated changes.

Weekly lock maintenance runs before 06:00 Monday in Asia/Tokyo. When Renovate
changes `composer.json` or `composer.lock`, the `Renovate lock files` workflow
resolves all five compatibility locks against the same manifest using Composer's
global PHP platform setting. It never installs dependencies or executes Composer
scripts/plugins. Resolution failures block automerging.

If the locks change, the workflow commits only those files to the Renovate branch
and explicitly dispatches CI on that branch. This is needed because a push with
`GITHUB_TOKEN` does not automatically start workflows. CI validates each lock and
runs tests on all six PHP versions, lint, and mutation testing on changed lines.
Renovate ignores the workflow's commit author when deciding whether it may rebase
the branch. The workflow checks the PR revision before pushing and never force
pushes.

If a lock-refresh run fails after pushing, rerun CI on the Renovate branch with
the base branch as the `base_ref` input. If dependency resolution or CI fails,
repair the dependency update in its PR before merging; do not bypass the checks.

install either app. No personal access token or new repository secret is needed.

repository's direct-to-main workflow without introducing required PRs or enabling

Renovate Approve app's review to satisfy them. See the

## Composer lock files

`composer.lock` is the PHP 8.5 lock file, used by Renovate, lint, mutation testing,
and documentation publishing. PHP 8.0–8.4 retain their version-specific
`composer.lock.php-*` files. For local development on an older PHP version, copy
the corresponding lock file to `composer.lock` before installing; restore the
tracked PHP 8.5 lock before committing unrelated changes.

Weekly lock maintenance runs before 06:00 Monday in Asia/Tokyo. When Renovate
changes `composer.json` or `composer.lock`, the `Renovate lock files` workflow
resolves all five compatibility locks against the same manifest using Composer's
global PHP platform setting. It never installs dependencies or executes Composer
scripts/plugins. Resolution failures block automerging.

If the locks change, the workflow commits only those files to the Renovate branch
and explicitly dispatches CI on that branch. This is needed because a push with
`GITHUB_TOKEN` does not automatically start workflows. CI validates each lock and
runs tests on all six PHP versions, lint, and mutation testing on changed lines.
Renovate ignores the workflow's commit author when deciding whether it may rebase
the branch. The workflow checks the PR revision before pushing and never force
pushes.

If a lock-refresh run fails after pushing, rerun CI on the Renovate branch with
the base branch as the `base_ref` input. If dependency resolution or CI fails,
repair the dependency update in its PR before merging; do not bypass the checks.

### Access inputs context in a workflow_dispatch workflow

Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/contexts

Uses input parameters defined in workflow_dispatch for manually triggered workflows.

```yaml
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      build_id:
        required: true
        type: string
      deploy_target:
        required: true
        type: string
      perform_deploy:
        required: true
        type: boolean

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ inputs.perform_deploy }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy build to target
        run: echo "Deploying build:${{ inputs.build_id }} to target:${{ inputs.deploy_target }}"
```
